name: Riajuu Bakuhatsu Shiro! ~Henshin Nouryoku Te ni Ireta Dakedo Shitsumon Aru?~
original_name: リア充爆発しろ！ ～変身能力手に入れたんだけど質問ある？～
source:
The main character, who has a communication disorder, lives a life where he doesn't interact with anyone, and as a result, he envies the so-called "real people" and at the same time makes them his enemies.

He was doing small things to vent his frustration every day, but
by chance he met a girl who was doing the same thing and the two decided to work together.

At the same time, the protagonist somehow acquires the "Mysterious ability to change his appearance'' and suddenly
puts his efforts into eradicating Ria.

Will the protagonist, who is a virgin and has a communication disorder, be able to win against Ria Mitsuru?

[Translated from DLsite]
translation:
患有沟通障碍的主角过着不与任何人交往的生活，因此他羡慕所谓的“真正的人”，同时也将他们视为敌人。

他每天都在做一些小事来发泄心中的不满，但是
一次偶然的机会，他认识了一个和她做同样事情的女孩，两人决定一起工作。

与此同时，主角莫名其妙地获得了“改变外貌的神秘能力”，突然间
努力消灭Ria。

身为处女且有沟通障碍的主角能否战胜满莉亚呢？

[摘自DLsite]
